faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ITDA Sahibganj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ITDA Sahibganj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 1 Hindi Teacher (TGT), 1 English Teacher (TGT), 1 Sanskrit Teacher (TGT), 1 Santhali Teacher (TGT), 1 Maths Teacher (TGT), 1 Social Science Teacher (TGT) and 6 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ITDA Sahibganj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (www.sahibganj.nic.in) and send it to जिला कल्याण कार्यालय, साहिबगंज, झारखण्ड, पिन कोड- 816109, by speed post / registered post, to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 60 years (as on 1 October 2026). Relaxation: Retired teachers from State Govt / KVS / NVS / CBSE schools 65.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 29,000 - Rs. 33,000 for Hindi Teacher (TGT), Rs. 29,000 - Rs. 33,000 for English Teacher (TGT), Rs. 29,000 - Rs. 33,000 for Sanskrit Teacher (TGT), Rs. 29,000 - Rs. 33,000 for Santhali Teacher (TGT), Rs. 29,000 - Rs. 33,000 for Maths Teacher (TGT).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate with B.Ed or relevant degree/diploma. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Local candidates will be given priority. Candidates must be physically healthy to work in residential school.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Walk-in Interview / Skill Test by district level committee.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is purely temporary and on contract for one year or till regular teacher is appointed.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Taljhari, Sahibganj.
